messages:
alex: Heads-up — we’re targeting the cross-service release in the 01:00 UTC change window (API/runtime/console/router). Need final sigs and rollback criteria.
priya: ack. Can we pin router -> v2.4.1 and runtime -> optics-2026-03? Console can be soft-rollout.
sam: +1 for pin. Router team will hold canary at 5% for 10m then 25%.
jin: runtime-oncall: latency baseline looks good on staging but KV eviction change might spike tail p99 if batching config flips. We should keep the old batching profile as fallback.
deploybot: Deploy scheduled by alex for 2026-03-25 01:00 UTC. Steps: 1) Canary router @5% 2) Canary runtime @10% 3) Scale console rollout 4) Traffic shift router -> 100%. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.
danielle: product: release notes ready, calling out KV eviction change and how to opt out via header `X-Runtime-Mode: legacy`. Also docs for rollback.
priya: rollback criteria proposal: - error rate increase > 1% for 5m OR - p99 latency > +250ms relative baseline for 5m OR - console 502 spike > 0.5%. If any tripped, trigger rollback.
runtime-oncall: noted. Add check on KV misses (delta > 20%) as a soft trigger. We’ll monitor with alert channel #eng-oncall.
sam: quick checklist for deploy: `pin router:v2.4.1`, `pin runtime:optics-2026-03`, update console flag `console.rollout=canary`, add routing policy `route: prefer-new` for canary.
alex: ops: who owns the rollback if runtime causes degradation? Runtime-oncall or deploy lead?
jin: runtime-oncall: we own initial rollback for runtime or submit quick rollback request. If cross-service issue, deploy lead (alex) coordinates full rollback.
danielle: product: add a customer-facing blurb in release notes about potential short-lived latency blips and opt-out header.
priya: add runbook snippet to the PR:
```
# rollback steps (fast)
1. deploybot rollback router to v2.4.0
2. deploybot rollback runtime to optics-2026-02
3. toggle console feature flag -> off
4. notify #prod-ops and product
```
product: confirmed we’ll broadcast if rollback happens.
deploybot: Canary started: router @5% (canary-id=cb-1749999123). Monitoring hooks enabled.
runtime-oncall: seeing small p95 bump +30ms on canary so far, within expected. KV miss steady.
sam: After 10m, move router to 25% and runtime to 25% if metrics stable.
priya: doing that now.
deploybot: Router canary moved to 25%. Runtime canary moved to 25%.
alex: motion: hold at 25% for 20m. Any red flags call rollback.
jin: there’s a small error spike in a subset of traffic from ap-south, investigating if it's header-related.
runtime-oncall: ap-south p50 fine but p99 +210ms — approaching threshold. We’re flipping the dashboard to isolate the KV path.
danielle: product: prepping comms just in case, but still green.
priya: decision note: if ap-south p99 crosses +250ms or errors >1% we rollback router first then runtime.
sam: agreed. Router rollback is fastest.
deploybot: Alert: ap-south error rate = 1.2% over 5m. Threshold breached for rollback.
alex: rollback now. Execute the runbook.
deploybot: Executing: rollback router -> v2.4.0 (started).
priya: rolling runtime rollback to optics-2026-02 queued in case router rollback doesn’t stabilize.
runtime-oncall: monitoring. If runtime still noisey after router rollback, we’ll trigger runtime rollback.
deploybot: Router rollback complete. Traffic healed to baseline. Canary ids closed.
jin: confirming p99 dropped back under threshold in ap-south. KV miss normalized.
danielle: product: pausing external notes; will update release notes to say we rolled back router due to ap-south anomaly and will re-run in a smaller window once root cause fixed.
alex: postmortem owners: runtime (jin) to investigate KV eviction sensitivity, router (sam) to validate header routing change, product (danielle) to update notes. Plan follow-up dry-run next week.
priya: adding follow-up tasks to the release PR and tagging owners.
deploybot: Deploy complete (rollback path executed). Summary: router rollback executed, runtime left at canary 25% then held, console never went to full. See logs: https://deploys.internal/1749999123
product: thanks everyone — good coordination. :clap:
